title: Baselines: Aurora on the same links, and every controller on Aurora's training links
description: The three Auroras trained with PCC-RL's code (exp-aurora-model-202: three unseeded training runs, each checked against PCC-RL's own code) as agent_rate agents (aurora-0, -1, -2), and each fed the RTT samples PCC-Uspace's deployment gives it (aurora-blind-I: first and last sample only, in whole seconds, so it sees no latency below 1 s). All six run alone on the same families, test links, conditions and campaign seed 31 as exp-baselines-192, exp-baselines-pure-194 and exp-baselines-orca-197, and as 2 and 4 copies. Then every controller (the six Auroras, expliCCit as deployed, Sage, Orca, BBRv1, BBRv3, Cubic and Vegas) runs alone for 60 s on 27 links drawn as PCC-RL's simulator draws Aurora's training links (experiments/heldout.py, family aurora-range: 1.2 to 6 Mbit/s, 50 to 500 ms one way, buffers of 2 to 2981 packets), clean and with 1% and 3% random loss, where experiments/baselines_report.py also scores each by Aurora's own reward.
prepare: (cd "$IN/aurora/aurora" && sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS); (cd "$IN/orca/orca" && sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS); SAGE="$IN/sage/sage/sage.onnx"; echo "fc0d6f1da45e4948ee3d96784642793954ed5e52adc1eddd0c9883d5d8fe2f9e  $SAGE" | sha256sum -c; A=(); for i in 0 1 2; do A+=(--policy "aurora-$i=$IN/aurora/aurora/aurora-$i.onnx@rate" --policy "aurora-blind-$i=$IN/aurora/aurora/aurora-blind-$i.onnx@rate"); done; for fd in training:30 new:30 deep-long:30 cubic-first:60 rise:30 cellular:30 case-studies:80; do f=${fd%:*} d=${fd#*:}; uv run python experiments/heldout.py "$OUT/spec-$f-$d" --split test --family "$f" --duration-ms "${d}000" --seed 31 --stock "" "${A[@]}"; uv run expliccit campaign plan "$OUT/spec-$f-$d/campaign.json" "$OUT/c-$f-$d"; done; uv run python experiments/copies.py "$OUT/copies" --split test --duration-ms 30000 --seed 31 --n 2 4 --stock "" "${A[@]}"; mv "$OUT/copies/c-copies-30s" "$OUT/"; uv run expliccit train import-expliccit third_party/expliccit-models "$OUT/expliccit" --as-deployed; uv run python experiments/heldout.py "$OUT/spec-aurora-range-60" --split test --family aurora-range --duration-ms 60000 --seed 31 --stock bbr,bbr3,cubic,vegas "${A[@]}" --policy "expliccit=$OUT/expliccit/policy.onnx" --policy "sage=$SAGE" --policy "orca=$IN/orca/orca/orca.onnx@cubic:20"; uv run expliccit campaign plan "$OUT/spec-aurora-range-60/campaign.json" "$OUT/c-aurora-range-60"; jq -s add "$OUT"/spec-*/aliases.json > "$OUT/aliases.json"
run: for c in "$OUT"/c-*; do uv run expliccit campaign run "$c" --shard "$SHARD/$SHARDS" --build "$UML" --workers "$WORKERS" --tables flow_seconds; done
